title: Ragtime, Melrose publishing and Al Rose
summary: Ragtime was learned as jazz; Melrose published his pieces in 1925; a Rose took them to dinner.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: It was the ragtime music, yes. But they all called it. Because in about that time, 1925, in Chicago, he was having some pieces published by Melrose.

Yes. And still has the music in the catalog. And not a, Mel, Mr. Mr. Melrose, there was somebody by the name of Rose, the man was named Rose himself, I think, that contacted us one day to take us out to dinner.
Oh, lovely. I know him, Al Rose, he's a friend of mine, too. Yes, yes. He took us out. He was written some things on the—
